title: Roofer
notice_text:
This apprenticeship standard is in the process of being revised. In the meantime, the version below remains approved for delivery. Further details of this and other occupational standards in revision are available in the revisions status report .
A temporary dispensation has been applied to the assessment plan version ST0270/AP01/V1.0 and ST0270/V1.1 for this apprenticeship. The dispensation will run indefinitely until all apprentices registered to ST0270/AP01/V1.0 and ST0270/V1.1 only, are complete. The dispensation may be withdrawn if no longer necessary. End-point assessment organisations (EPAOs) delivering EPAs for the apprenticeship will implement the dispensation as required, supported, and monitored by the relevant EQA provider.
The key changes are:
To allow assessment method 2, ‘observation with questioning’ to be delivered in a simulated learning environment. The assessment of working at height safely will be evidenced in the portfolio as part of S1 and confirmed in the interview.
Overview of the role
Installing a range of roofing materials and products.
version_log: End-point assessment plan and standard revised
